transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, yeah… thanks for seeing me. I’m a barber, and I guess I’ve been having a hard time at work with the straight razor. I know that probably sounds kind of ridiculous in my line of work, but I’ve started doing things to avoid using it—like switching clients around, saying I can’t find the blade, or just putting it away in the drawer.

And if I can’t get out of it, I can still do the shave, but I’m shaking through the whole thing. It’s gotten bad enough that I figured I should probably talk to someone, if that makes sense.
When you have to use the straight razor, is the main fear that you might accidentally cut or seriously hurt the client?

Yeah… I think that’s basically it. I mean, I know it’s just a tool, and I trained with it—I can use clippers all day without thinking. But when the straight razor is open at my station, it suddenly feels like I’m about to hurt somebody, or cut myself really badly. I know that probably sounds dramatic, but that’s what it feels like.
When the straight razor is in your hand, do you get unwanted thoughts or urges about hurting the client?

Um… I don’t think it’s like an urge, no. I’m not sitting there wanting to hurt anyone or anything like that. It’s more like… I get scared because the razor is right there and it feels dangerous, if that makes sense.

I guess sometimes the thought pops in like, “What if I slip?” but it’s not something I want. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean.
Do you find yourself repeatedly checking the straight razor to make sure it’s safe before you use it?

I don’t think so, no. Not repeatedly, anyway. I mean, I might look at it or make sure it’s closed or set down right, like anyone would, I guess… but I’m not checking it over and over to feel okay.

It’s more that once I know I have to use it, I get nervous just having it there. Is that… does that answer what you mean?
Is the fear mainly just about the straight razor itself?

Mostly, yeah… it’s the straight razor itself, or I guess what it could do. I know it’s just a tool I was trained to use, and I’m fine with clippers all day, but when the razor is open at my station, I get this feeling like I’m about to hurt somebody or cut myself really badly.

I know that probably sounds worse than I mean it to, but that’s the part that scares me.
Do you feel the same kind of fear around other sharp objects, like knives?

Not really, no… I mean, kitchen knives or scissors don’t usually do that to me. I’m okay around those for the most part.

It’s more that straight razor at work. I know it’s just a tool, and I trained with it, and I can use clippers all day without thinking twice. But when the razor is open at my station, it just feels like I’m about to hurt somebody or cut myself badly. I know that sounds dramatic… but that’s the feeling.
Do you get this fear even when you’re just looking at the straight razor and not using it?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I’m falling apart just seeing it, but yes. Even if I’m not using it yet, if I hear a client ask for a razor shave or I see the blade flipped open, it kind of hits right away.

My chest tightens, my hands get sweaty, and it’s like my body wants me to step back before I’ve even really thought about it. Does that make sense?
Do you also get this fear when you see blood?

Um… I don’t think so, not in the same way. I mean, blood isn’t pleasant or anything, but I haven’t really noticed that same panic feeling just from seeing blood.

It’s more tied to the razor, I think… if that answers what you’re asking.
Do you still feel afraid when the straight razor is closed and just sitting there?

When it’s closed… it’s not as bad, I guess. I can usually tell myself it’s just sitting there.

But if it’s open at my station, that’s when it really gets to me. I know it’s a tool I trained with, and I can use clippers all day without any issue, but with the straight razor open, I get this feeling like I’m about to cut myself badly or hurt somebody. I know that probably sounds extreme, but that’s honestly what goes through my mind.
If someone else is using the straight razor and you’re just watching, do you still feel afraid?

Yeah… I think I do, honestly. Maybe not as intense as when it’s in my own hand or right there at my station, but if I’m watching someone with it open, I still get that feeling.

I know it’s just a tool, and I’ve trained with it, so I feel kind of embarrassed saying it. I can use clippers all day with no problem. But when that straight razor is open, my mind goes straight to, like, someone’s going to get cut badly or I’m going to somehow hurt somebody. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
